analysis: paired bootstrap CIs and Wilcoxon tests for ranking comparisons
miss_rank_rule: assign rank K+1 to a target not retrieved within the top K

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap resampling the same query indices for both methods
bootstrap.rng_call_order: baseline, cutoff, then MRR, hit rate, and all-query mean rank

wilcoxon_test.statistic: two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-query reciprocal ranks
wilcoxon_test.approximation: normal approximation with tie correction and no continuity correction
